subject: Evidence delivery: personnel lifecycle snapshot and training logs for Ancestry Health audit
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@ancestryhealth.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: sample personnel lifecycle evidence for upcoming SIG/SOC2 review

Hi Rohan,

Our SOC2 assessor (BrightShield) has asked us to collect a small sample of personnel lifecycle evidence from subcontractors and vendors. Specifically they want:

- Training completion records for 25 recently onboarded contributors (status, completion date, training modules).
- Proof of baseline background checks for the same cohort (redacted PII is fine).
- Onboarding and offboarding timestamps + the deprovisioning checklist for any leavers in the sample.
- Any attestation or retention policy that governs background check artifacts.

Can Redwood provide a consolidated bundle or a secure link to a redacted bundle? Ideally we need an initial package by 2028-07-07 to feed to the assessor.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if that helps.

— Marta
Marta Lopez
Senior Security Program Manager
Ancestry Health
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@ancestryhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-24T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sample personnel lifecycle evidence for upcoming SIG/SOC2 review

On Mon, Jun 24, 2028 at 09:12 AM Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@ancestryhealth.com> wrote:
> Our SOC2 assessor (BrightShield) has asked us to collect a small sample of personnel lifecycle evidence from subcontractors and vendors....

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely compile a redacted bundle. Proposed plan:

1) Initial deliverable (by 2028-06-30): redacted training logs + a manifest describing redaction/hash mapping, and a sample set (25) of background check evidence with PII removed.
2) Follow-up (by 2028-07-06): onboarding/offboarding matrix showing timestamps, playbook excerpts, and audit log snippets for the sample cohort.

Monica will assemble the files and Karthik will provide the retention/third-party vendor details.

Two quick clarifying Qs for the assessor: do you prefer hashed employee IDs (sha256) instead of pseudonyms? And is a Drive link acceptable or do you need an S3 presigned bundle?

I'll start the bundle and share a secure link once the first zip is staged.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Head of Sales Operations (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-25T14:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sample personnel lifecycle evidence for upcoming SIG/SOC2 review

Rohan — starting to pull together the artifacts. Notes below:

- training_logs_2028_q2.csv (columns: hashed_employee_id, module_id, completion_date, status) — will include 25 rows per your sample.
- bg_checks_redacted_2028-06.zip — contains PDF redacted outputs from our background-check vendor (CheckPoint Screening). PII redacted, vendor attestation included as vendor_statement.txt.
- onboarding_offboarding_matrix.pdf — one-page matrix with join/leave timestamps and deprovisioning checklist status.
- onboarding_runbook_excerpt.md — excerpts of the playbook that show the automated deprovisioning workflow (workflow IDs and owners).

I'll also include a README (manifest.txt) that explains redaction, hashing method (sha256 salted with org salt), and retention window (background-check artifacts retained for 7 years per policy).

ETA for the first bundle: end of day 2028-06-30. If BrightShield needs a different format, tell me and I can adapt.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-27T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding/offboarding controls and retention details

Folks — quick technical details to include in the snapshot:

- Background checks: third-party vendor \"CheckPoint Screening\" (contract signed 2026-11). They provide a vendor statement (will include) and we store raw artifacts in a secured bucket; only redacted copies are shared.
- Onboarding automation: new hire provisioning is triggered by HR LMS event; the runbook excerpt will show the provisioning play and the automation job id (auto-provision-0042).
- Offboarding: deprovisioning occurs via the offboard service with an audit webhook to our identity provider; I will include a 2-day audit log snippet showing access revocations (timestamps and the service names).

Inline sample audit log snippet (redacted):
[2028-05-12T14:03:15Z] USER_HASH=3f7a... ACTION=REMOVE_ACCESS SERVICE=internal-notebooks OWNER=infra-ops
[2028-05-12T14:03:16Z] USER_HASH=3f7a... ACTION=REVOKE_TOKENS SERVICE=api-gateway OWNER=auth-team

I'll also include our personnel retention policy (policy_v2.1.pdf) and a short attestations.txt that the artifacts are accurate to the best of our knowledge.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@ancestryhealth.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: BrightShield Audit Team <audit@brightshield.com>
Date: 2028-06-28T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence delivery: personnel lifecycle snapshot and training logs for Ancestry Health audit

Rohan/Team — this looks good, thank you. A few quick clarifications from the assessor:

- Please use hashed employee IDs (sha256) rather than names.
- Add a \"completion_status\" column in the training log that indicates whether remedial training was required.
- For the background checks, include vendor attestation and the date the check was performed.

BrightShield also asked whether Redwood can provide a signed attestation that the bundle is complete for the sample and whether any exceptions exist. If you can add a short signed note (PDF), that'll speed review.

Otherwise the Drive link works for us; we can pull the bundle from there.

Best,
Marta
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@ancestryhealth.com>, BrightShield Audit Team <audit@brightshield.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence delivery: personnel lifecycle snapshot and training logs for Ancestry Health audit

Marta / BrightShield — bundle attached and staged to a secure Drive folder. Summary of what we've provided:

Attachments (in the bundle):
- training_logs_2028_q2.csv (25 hashed_employee_id rows; includes completion_status and remedial flag)
- bg_checks_redacted_2028-06.zip (redacted PDFs + vendor_statement.txt with CheckPoint Screening attestation and check dates)
- onboarding_offboarding_matrix.pdf (timestamps and deprovisioning checklist status for the cohort)
- onboarding_runbook_excerpt.md (automation flow and job ids)
- manifest.txt (hashing method, salt handling notes, retention policy reference)
- attestations.pdf (signed attestation statement from Redwood Security leadership)

Secure links: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/abcd1234 (view-only, access logged)
Alternate S3 bundle: https://s3.redwood-inference.com/audit-bundles/ancestry/snapshot-20280630/ (presigned link, expires 2028-07-07)

We hashed employee identifiers using sha256 with an internal salt and included a mapping only in the secure vault (not shared). The manifest explains the exact process. If BrightShield needs a notarized attestation instead of PDF, let us know and we'll route to Legal.

Next steps: Monica will confirm the Drive ACLs and add a delivery note to the HubSpot ticket (HB-3321). If the assessor requests more rows or a different cohort, we can expand the sample.

Thanks — Rohan

Attachments: training_logs_2028_q2.csv, bg_checks_redacted_2028-06.zip, onboarding_offboarding_matrix.pdf, onboarding_runbook_excerpt.md, manifest.txt, attestations.pdf
